newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-AUXERRE V GLASGOW RANGERS TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUXERRE V GLASGOW RANGERS TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for the European Champions' League group A match between Auxerre of France and Glasgow Rangers of Scotland on Wednesday:

Auxerre - 16-Fabien Cool; 2-Alain Goma, 13-Frederic Danjou, 4-Franck Silvestre, 3-Franck Rabarivony; 22-Eric Assati, 8-Moussa Saib, 6-Philippe Violeau; 17-Steve Marlet, 9-Lilian Laslandes, 28-Fabrice Lepaul.

Rangers - 1-Andy Goram; 15-David Robertson, 4-Richard Gough, 5-Gordan Petric, 23-Craig Moore, 28-Greg Shields; 20-Derek McInnes, 24-Ian Ferguson, 22-Trevor Steven; 18-Erik Bo Andersen, 17-Peter van Vossen.
